about.title: What is MOVEN
about.p1: MOVEN is the Mission Hub of the UNASP-HT Church. The name was created to express movement, purpose, and mission.
about.p2: The number 7 appears subtly in the logo. It represents the seventh day, our Adventist identity, reminding us that the God who invites us to rest in His love also calls us to share it with the world.
about.p3: We are a mission hub and School of Missions of the UNASP Hortolândia Adventist Church, in partnership with the Adventist Volunteer Service (SVA). Our goals:
goals: Establish a permanent mission hub within the local church.
Equip people to make disciples through service wherever they are.
Inspire and train others to embrace the mission.

verses.text: Love is the mark of Jesus' disciples.
We are called to go and make disciples.

amazon.title: Missions & Expeditions
amazon.subtitle: Discover our featured expedition and upcoming hub missions. The minimum to charter the boat is 28 spots, with an open waitlist for new cohorts and extra spots.
amazon.p1: In partnership with the Northwest Mission, we will spend 10 days by boat along the Amazon rivers, following the Salva-Vidas Amazônia project model. Activities include construction, evangelism, basic healthcare, and kitchen support alongside riverbank communities.
amazon.p2: Volunteers sleep in hammocks with mosquito nets provided. Mission participants must be certified by the in-person School of Missions.
beforeItems: Participants under 16 must travel with parents/guardians. Ages 16–17 require notarized parental consent.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Data Protection (LGPD)
privacy.updated: Last updated: Version 2026.1 · MOVEN · Mission Hub · UNASP-HT Church
privacy.legalNotice: Legal notice: This translation is for informational purposes only. For legal purposes under Brazilian law, the original Portuguese version prevails.
privacy.s1Intro: MOVEN (Mission Hub of the UNASP-HT Church) collects your personal data (Full Name, Email, Phone/WhatsApp, and CPF) exclusively to:
s1Items: Process and manage your enrollment in the School of Missions and/or Amazon Mission 2027;
Issue attendance lists, badges, and completion certificates;
Arrange mandatory travel insurance and registration in the Adventist Volunteer Service (SVA / VividFaith);
Maintain pastoral contact, class announcements, and mission logistics guidance.
privacy.s2Body: MOVEN does not sell, rent, or share your data with any third parties for commercial or advertising purposes. Data is shared strictly with required denominational bodies (SVA / Central São Paulo Conference / Northwest Mission) for mission and insurance purposes.
privacy.s3Body: In accordance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13.709/2018), you have the right to request confirmation of processing, access, correction of incomplete data, or deletion of your data after the mission project concludes by contacting coordination through our official channel:
privacy.s4Body: We only use essential cookies for session authentication and navigation preferences. Data is protected by encryption and Row Level Security (RLS) access control in our PostgreSQL database.

terms.title: Terms of Use & General Conditions
terms.subtitle: MOVEN · Mission Hub · UNASP-HT Church · 2026/2027 Edition
terms.legalNotice: Legal notice: This translation is for informational purposes only. For legal purposes under Brazilian law, the original Portuguese version prevails.
s1Items: The R$ 170.00 fee is a one-time enrollment fee and includes the student kit (ecobag, t-shirt, Passport to Mission book, notebook, pen, and completion diploma).
Certification requires 100% in-person attendance, at least 70% overall score on activities, and 80% attendance at biweekly sessions.
s2Items: The mission will take place from July 19 to 29, 2027, in partnership with the Salva-Vidas Amazônia project (Northwest Mission).
Airfare: The São Paulo–Manaus flight is not included in the R$ 2,500.00 fee and is the volunteer's sole responsibility.
Spots: Strictly limited to 28 confirmed spots (upon payment), respecting the technical and safety capacity of the boat.
Prerequisites: Certification from the School of Missions, approved SVA/VividFaith registration, and up-to-date mandatory vaccines (yellow fever and tetanus).
Minors: Participants under 16 must be accompanied by parents or legal guardians. Ages 16 to 17 require written, notarized parental authorization.
terms.s3Body: Cancellations requested up to 60 days before the start of the expedition will be refunded according to the fixed-cost policies already contracted for the boat and insurance. Administrative card or bank slip processing fees are non-refundable.
